MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo and bulb kit feels like a useful next step because it adds voice control and lighting to my existing Fire TV setup.",
    "The memory card and reader connect to my recent camcorder purchase through a practical storage and transfer need, though I would check compatibility before buying."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD and previous-generation Fire TV sticks duplicate functions I already have through my 4K stick and Fire TV television without offering a clear improvement.",
    "The tablets and sport earbuds do not address a current need suggested by my home entertainment, camera, and security purchases.",
    "The WiFi extender could support connected devices, but owning cameras does not mean I have a coverage problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Fire-branded device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Several Alexa speakers fit the same potential need, but I would choose the newer Echo and bulb kit rather than buy multiple generations."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a useful addition should extend my setup or offer a clear upgrade over equipment I have.",
    "Accessories are appealing when they support a specific device and are compatible with it; a possible connection alone is not enough.",
    "I need a concrete reason to add equipment, such as a new capability or an actual problem to solve."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my connected-home interests but too often treat shared branding or overlapping functions as a reason to buy more."
}
